candidate_intervention_classes.name: Forecast-Aware SOC Reserve / Terminal-State Policy
candidate_intervention_classes.observed_v2_evidence: M2/M4: Early morning battery SOC divergence precedes evening diesel commitment.
candidate_intervention_classes.engineering_hypothesis: Dynamic SOC floor reservation during morning hours prevents SOC depletion prior to un-forecasted solar drops.
candidate_intervention_classes.future_intervention: Formally declared dynamic SOC floor constraint added to MILP formulation.
candidate_intervention_classes.unchanged_ems_behavior: MILP power flow equations, diesel physical bounds, generator startup logic
candidate_intervention_classes.risks: Over-conservative SOC reservation may unnecessarily trigger diesel when solar is available
candidate_intervention_classes.falsification_criterion: If dynamic SOC reserve fails to reduce diesel fuel while increasing renewable curtailment, hypothesis is rejected

candidate_intervention_classes.name: Forecast-Uncertainty-Aware Battery Dispatch Constraints
candidate_intervention_classes.observed_v2_evidence: M2/M5: Multi-horizon forecast shape differences lead to early battery dispatch divergence.
candidate_intervention_classes.engineering_hypothesis: Capping maximum battery discharge rate during candidate morning forecast horizons preserves SOC buffer.
candidate_intervention_classes.future_intervention: Formally declared horizon-specific battery discharge cap constraints.
candidate_intervention_classes.unchanged_ems_behavior: Battery capacity E_cap=200kWh, inverter efficiency eta=0.95, load serving priority
candidate_intervention_classes.risks: Discharge cap may force early diesel dispatch when battery power was sufficient to serve load
candidate_intervention_classes.falsification_criterion: If discharge caps increase diesel commitment steps without reducing total fuel, hypothesis is rejected

candidate_intervention_classes.name: Diesel Commitment Hysteresis / Minimum-Runtime Logic
candidate_intervention_classes.observed_v2_evidence: M1/M3: Treatment exhibited fewer startups (178 vs 346) but longer continuous runs (400 vs 346 steps) at higher power (33.79 kW vs 10.0 kW).
candidate_intervention_classes.engineering_hypothesis: Tests whether commitment hysteresis / minimum-runtime logic alters generator operating behavior under the frozen forecast/truth environment.
candidate_intervention_classes.future_intervention: Formally declared MILP objective penalty for rapid generator state transitions.
candidate_intervention_classes.unchanged_ems_behavior: Diesel minimum output limit P_min=15kW, marginal fuel curve
candidate_intervention_classes.risks: Excessive hysteresis locks diesel ON unnecessarily, increasing fuel consumption and curtailment
candidate_intervention_classes.falsification_criterion: If hysteresis logic increases total diesel-active timesteps without reducing fuel, hypothesis is rejected

candidate_intervention_classes.name: Renewable-Absorption-Aware Diesel Commitment Logic
candidate_intervention_classes.observed_v2_evidence: M1/M3: Renewable curtailment occurs during active diesel commitment due to P_min=15kW constraints.
candidate_intervention_classes.engineering_hypothesis: Adding a solar absorption credit to the MILP objective tests whether daytime diesel commitment is suppressed.
candidate_intervention_classes.future_intervention: Formally declared daytime curtailment penalty weight in MILP objective.
candidate_intervention_classes.unchanged_ems_behavior: Load serving hard constraint, battery power bounds
candidate_intervention_classes.risks: Daytime diesel suppression may cause SOC depletion immediately before evening peak
candidate_intervention_classes.falsification_criterion: If curtailment penalty shifts diesel run hours to evening without reducing total fuel, hypothesis is rejected

candidate_intervention_classes.name: Robust MPC / Conservative Treatment of Forecast Uncertainty
candidate_intervention_classes.observed_v2_evidence: M2/M5/M6: Multi-horizon forecast optimism drives early battery dispatch divergence.
candidate_intervention_classes.engineering_hypothesis: Tests whether conservative forecast quantile evaluation reduces over-optimistic dispatch decisions.
candidate_intervention_classes.prerequisite_note: Stage8.1 ForecastBundle uses degenerate lower=point=upper format with zero statistical coverage claims. An external uncertainty-estimation methodology is required prior to any implementation of Class E.
candidate_intervention_classes.future_intervention: External uncertainty estimation model + quantile-constrained MILP formulation.
candidate_intervention_classes.unchanged_ems_behavior: MILP cost objective weights, simulator physics
candidate_intervention_classes.risks: Excessive conservatism causes systematic over-generation and unnecessary diesel commitment
candidate_intervention_classes.falsification_criterion: If quantile conservatism increases mean diesel fuel across 173 origins, hypothesis is rejected

candidate_intervention_classes.name: Horizon-Weighted MPC Objective or Constraint Treatment
candidate_intervention_classes.observed_v2_evidence: M5/M6: Multi-horizon forecast shape vector differences precede H1 error manifestations.
candidate_intervention_classes.engineering_hypothesis: Tests whether discounting objective weights for predeclared distant forecast horizons aligns MILP decisions with forecast decay.
candidate_intervention_classes.future_intervention: Formally declared horizon-decay weighting factor applied to MILP objective horizons.
candidate_intervention_classes.unchanged_ems_behavior: Physical conservation of energy constraints, H1 action execution
candidate_intervention_classes.risks: Heavy horizon discounting makes MPC myopic, causing failure to prepare for known multi-hour load peaks
candidate_intervention_classes.falsification_criterion: If horizon discounting causes late-horizon energy deficits or constraint violations, hypothesis is rejected

candidate_intervention_classes.name: Combined Battery-SOC + Diesel Commitment Policy
candidate_intervention_classes.observed_v2_evidence: M1/M2/M3/M4: Interacting sequence between SOC depletion, generator commitment, and curtailment.
candidate_intervention_classes.engineering_hypothesis: Tests whether a state-dependent coupling constraint linking minimum SOC floor to generator commitment state optimizes dispatch.
candidate_intervention_classes.future_intervention: Formally declared joint reserve coupling constraint in MILP formulation.
candidate_intervention_classes.unchanged_ems_behavior: Digital twin simulator physical transition equations
candidate_intervention_classes.risks: Increased formulation complexity could increase MILP solve times or cause numerical infeasibilities
candidate_intervention_classes.falsification_criterion: If joint policy triggers MILP infeasibilities or fails to reduce diesel fuel, hypothesis is rejected
